<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Bake Off Fantasy League 2026</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Young+Serif&family=Instrument+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap">
<style>
:root{
  color-scheme:light;
  --bg:#e9f6f3; --panel:#ffffff; --ink:#27393b; --muted:#5d6f70; --line:#c3e0da;
  --aqua:#8ed4cc; --aqua-deep:#2f8f89; --sage:#aab6a6; --wood:#dcae6e; --floor:#cdb083;
  --red:#c8324a; --navy:#2b3f6b; --custard:#f4cf63; --gone:#8c9796; --gone-bg:#e6e9e6; --on-aqua:#14302e;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 16px/1.5 "Instrument Sans",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}
.wrap{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 18px 64px}
.bunting{display:block;width:100%;height:34px;color:var(--muted)}
.arch{display:block;width:min(360px,80%);margin:6px auto 0}
.top{text-align:center}
h1{font:400 clamp(2.2rem,7vw,3.6rem)/1.05 "Young Serif",Georgia,serif;margin:10px 0 6px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.lede{color:var(--muted);margin:0 auto 22px;max-width:60ch}
h2{font:400 1.35rem/1.2 "Young Serif",Georgia,serif;margin:0 0 4px}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;border-bottom:8px solid var(--wood);margin-bottom:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
.tabs button{font:inherit;font-weight:600;background:var(--panel);border:2px solid var(--line);border-bottom:none;color:var(--muted);padding:9px 16px;border-radius:10px 10px 0 0;cursor:pointer}
.tabs button[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--aqua);border-color:var(--aqua);color:var(--on-aqua)}
button:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--aqua-deep);outline-offset:2px}
.bar{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:16px}
.bar p{margin:0;color:var(--muted)}
.btn{font:inherit;font-weight:600;border:2px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer}
.btn.primary{background:var(--aqua);border-color:var(--aqua);color:var(--on-aqua)}
.btn.small{padding:4px 10px;font-size:.85rem}
.btn[disabled]{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}
.notice{background:var(--panel);border:2px dashed var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px;color:var(--muted)}
.rows{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:10px}
.row{background:var(--panel);border:2px solid var(--line);border-left:10px solid var(--sage);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr auto;gap:6px 12px;align-items:center}
.row.lead{border-left-color:var(--aqua)}
.row.out{opacity:.72}
.rank{font:400 1.7rem/1 "Young Serif",Georgia,serif;text-align:center}
.pts{text-align:right;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.9}
.pts strong{font:400 1.7rem/1 "Young Serif",Georgia,serif;color:var(--ink)}
.who{font-weight:700;font-size:1.08rem}
.status{color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem}
.slots{grid-column:1/-1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:6px}
.slot{border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:6px 10px;min-width:0}
.slot small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.75rem}
.slot b{display:block;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.slot.active{border-color:var(--aqua-deep);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--aqua) 28%,var(--panel))}
.slot.gone{background:var(--gone-bg);border-color:transparent}
.slot.gone b{text-decoration:line-through;color:var(--gone);font-weight:500}
.slot.champ{border-color:var(--custard);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--custard) 35%,var(--panel))}
.floor{background:var(--floor);border-radius:16px;padding:16px}
.front{background:var(--aqua);color:var(--on-aqua);border-top:8px solid var(--wood);border-radius:8px;text-align:center;padding:8px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:24px}
.stations{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:26px 64px}
.station{position:relative;background:#fffdf8;border:6px solid #8ed4cc;border-radius:10px;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 4px 0 rgba(60,40,10,.28)}
.station:nth-child(4n+3),.station:nth-child(4n+4){border-color:#aab6a6}
.station .art{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:4px 4px 0 0}
.station .info{padding:8px 12px 12px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:10px;align-items:start}
.face{width:64px;height:64px;margin-top:-30px;border-radius:50%;border:4px solid #fffdf8;background:#8ed4cc;color:#14302e;display:grid;place-items:center;font:400 1.6rem/1 "Young Serif",Georgia,serif;overflow:hidden;position:relative;box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(60,40,10,.25)}
.face img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.station.gone .face{filter:grayscale(1);border-color:var(--gone-bg);box-shadow:none}
.station h3{font:400 1.25rem/1.2 "Young Serif",Georgia,serif;margin:0 0 2px}
.station p{margin:2px 0;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted)}
.station .stars{color:var(--ink);font-weight:700}
.towel{position:absolute;right:24px;bottom:-18px;width:22px;height:18px;border-radius:0 0 3px 3px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#fff 0 3px,#2b3f6b 3px 5px)}
.station.gone{background:var(--gone-bg);border-style:dashed;border-color:var(--gone);box-shadow:none;color:var(--gone)}
.station.gone .art{filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.5}
.station.gone h3{text-decoration:line-through}
.station.gone p{color:var(--gone)}
.station.gone .towel{display:none}
.station.champ{border-color:var(--custard)}
.week{background:var(--panel);border:2px solid var(--line);border-top:8px solid var(--wood);border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:12px}
.week header{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:baseline;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px}
.week header input{font:inherit;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:4px 8px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);width:11em}
.week .sum{margin:2px 0;color:var(--muted)}
.week .sum strong{color:var(--ink)}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin:6px 0 10px}
.chip{font:inherit;border:2px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 12px;cursor:pointer}
.chip[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);text-decoration:line-through}
label{display:block;font-weight:600;font-size:.9rem;margin:12px 0 4px}
label span{font-weight:400;color:var(--muted)}
select,input[type=text]{font:inherit;width:100%;padding:9px 10px;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}
.week select{width:100%}
.sels{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:4px 12px}
.sels label{margin-top:6px}
.fl{margin:8px 0 0;font-weight:600;font-size:.9rem}
.chip.hs[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--aqua);border-color:var(--aqua-deep);color:var(--on-aqua);text-decoration:none}
dialog{border:2px solid var(--line);border-top:10px solid var(--wood);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);padding:22px;width:min(440px,calc(100vw - 28px))}
dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(20,36,34,.55)}
.err{color:var(--red);font-weight:600;min-height:1.4em;margin:10px 0 0}
.actions{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.rules{margin-top:28px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem;max-width:66ch}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .slots{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .row{grid-template-columns:36px 1fr auto}
  .stations{gap:24px 18px}
  .station .info{padding:6px 8px 10px;gap:6px}
  .face{width:44px;height:44px;margin-top:-22px;font-size:1.1rem;border-width:3px}
  .floor{padding:12px}
}
body{background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(142,212,204,.17) 50%,transparent 50%),linear-gradient(rgba(142,212,204,.17) 50%,transparent 50%);background-size:40px 40px}
.hero{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;margin-top:14px;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 7px 0 var(--wood),0 16px 28px rgba(39,57,59,.16)}
.ribbon{display:inline-block;margin-top:26px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:.85rem;padding:4px 16px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px}
.tile{background:var(--panel);border:2px solid var(--line);border-top:8px solid var(--wood);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;text-align:center;min-width:0}
.tile b{display:block;font:400 1.6rem/1.15 "Young Serif",Georgia,serif;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.tile span{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted)}
.tile.hi{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--custard) 30%,var(--panel));border-color:var(--custard);border-top-color:var(--wood)}
.rank{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.3rem}
.rank.r1{background:var(--custard);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--panel),0 0 0 5px var(--custard)}
.rank.r2{background:#d5dbe0;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--panel),0 0 0 5px #d5dbe0}
.rank.r3{background:#e9b78f;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--panel),0 0 0 5px #e9b78f}
.row{box-shadow:0 3px 0 rgba(39,57,59,.08)}
.row.lead{border-left-color:var(--custard);background:linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--custard) 30%,var(--panel)),var(--panel) 65%)}
.meter{grid-column:1/-1;height:10px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--bg);overflow:hidden;margin-top:2px}
.meter i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:99px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,var(--aqua) 0 10px,#b4e5df 10px 20px);transition:width .6s}
.slot{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.slot>div{min-width:0}
.slot em{display:block;font-style:normal;font-size:.75rem;color:var(--muted)}
.mini{flex:none;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font:400 .95rem/1 "Young Serif",Georgia,serif;color:#14302e;overflow:hidden;border:2px solid var(--panel);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.mini img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.slot.gone .mini{filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.6}
.floor{background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.2) 1px,transparent 1.6px);background-size:9px 9px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
.week header{align-items:center}
.bis{flex:none;width:40px;height:40px;margin:3px;border-radius:50%;background:#e2b678;border:2px dashed #b98445;outline:3px solid #e2b678;display:grid;place-items:center;font:400 1.1rem/1 "Young Serif",Georgia,serif;color:#3b2a12}
.station,.row,.tile,.week{transition:transform .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease}
.station:hover,.tile:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}}
.enter .row,.enter .station,.enter .week,.enter .tile{animation:rise .45s both}
.enter :nth-child(2){animation-delay:.05s}.enter :nth-child(3){animation-delay:.1s}.enter :nth-child(4){animation-delay:.15s}.enter :nth-child(5){animation-delay:.2s}.enter :nth-child(6){animation-delay:.25s}.enter :nth-child(n+7){animation-delay:.3s}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.enter *{animation:none!important}.station,.row,.tile,.week,.meter i{transition:none}}
@media (max-width:560px){.tiles{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.mini{width:26px;height:26px;font-size:.8rem}}
.tech{position:relative;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:16px;padding:16px 12px 0;background:#f4eddc;border:2px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 5px 0 var(--wood)}
.tech::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:clamp(96px,22vw,150px);background-color:#fff;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(43,63,107,.32) 50%,transparent 50%),linear-gradient(rgba(43,63,107,.32) 50%,transparent 50%);background-size:24px 24px;border-top:4px solid rgba(43,63,107,.25)}
.tech-title{position:relative;z-index:1;margin:0 0 8px;text-align:center;font:400 1.15rem/1.2 "Young Serif",Georgia,serif;color:#3b2a12}
.tech-row{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;align-items:end}
.place{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;min-width:0;padding-bottom:12px}
.place svg{display:block;width:min(230px,100%);height:auto;margin-top:10px}
.place.p2 svg{width:min(200px,94%)}
.place.p3 svg{width:min(170px,86%)}
.tag{max-width:100%;background:#fff;border:4px solid var(--wood);border-radius:6px;padding:6px 12px;text-align:center;color:#27393b;box-shadow:0 3px 0 rgba(60,40,10,.2)}
.tag b{display:block;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;font-size:1.02rem}
.tag small{color:#5d6f70}
.tag.empty{border-style:dashed;opacity:.75}
.num{margin-top:6px;width:56px;height:48px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#fff;border:2px solid #27393b;border-radius:4px 4px 0 0;font:400 1.8rem/1 "Young Serif",Georgia,serif;color:#27393b;box-shadow:0 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.p1 .num{background:var(--custard)}
.enter .place{animation:rise .5s both}
@media (max-width:560px){.tag{padding:4px 6px;border-width:3px}.tag b{font-size:.9rem}}
.tag{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:4px 12px}
.tag>small{flex-basis:100%}
.pl{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;min-width:0;max-width:100%}
.pface{width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
.whoWrap{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;min-width:0}
.pmini{flex:none;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:3px solid var(--panel);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--aqua)}
@media (max-width:560px){.pface{width:52px;height:52px}.pmini{width:38px;height:38px}}
.pubnote{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;margin:0 0 14px}
.pubnote.warn{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--custard) 35%,var(--panel));border:2px solid var(--custard);border-radius:12px;padding:8px 12px;color:var(--ink)}
.station .pk{margin-top:6px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
.pkl{margin:2px 0 0;padding-left:18px;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted)}
.pkl li{margin:1px 0}
.mts{grid-column:1/-1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:4px}
.mt{background:var(--panel);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-top:4px solid var(--wood);border-radius:6px;text-align:center;padding:3px 2px 4px;min-width:0}
.mt b{display:block;font:400 1.05rem/1.15 "Young Serif",Georgia,serif;color:var(--ink)}
.mt span{display:block;font-size:.62rem;line-height:1.15;color:var(--muted)}
.mt.on{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--custard) 30%,var(--panel));border-color:var(--custard);border-top-color:var(--wood)}
.station.gone .mt{background:transparent;border-color:var(--gone)}
.station.gone .mt b{color:var(--gone)}
.rest{grid-column:1/-1;min-width:0}
@media (max-width:560px){.mts{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
.tag.many{gap:1px 10px;padding:6px 8px}
.tag.many b{font-size:.86rem}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<svg class="bunting" viewBox="0 0 480 34" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">
  <path d="M0 3 Q240 9 480 3" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <g id="flags"></g>
</svg>
<div class="wrap">
  <div class="top">
  <svg class="hero" viewBox="0 0 800 270" role="img" aria-label="Illustration of the Bake Off tent" id="hero"></svg>
  <span class="ribbon">Series 17, 2026</span>
  <h1>Bake Off Fantasy League</h1>
  <p class="lede">Four bakers each: a captain, Baker #1, Baker #2 and a bench pick who subs in when one of them leaves. Points every week for what your bakers do in the tent.</p>
  </div>
  <div id="pub"></div>
  <div class="tabs" role="tablist">
    <button role="tab" data-tab="standings" aria-selected="true">Standings</button>
    <button role="tab" data-tab="bakers" aria-selected="false">The tent</button>
    <button role="tab" data-tab="weeks" aria-selected="false">Week by week</button>
  </div>
  <main id="view"><p class="notice">Loading the league…</p></main>
</div>

<dialog id="dlg">
  <h2 id="dlgTitle">Add picks</h2>
  <label for="pName">Player name</label>
  <input type="text" id="pName" maxlength="30" autocomplete="off">
  <label for="s0">Captain</label><select id="s0"></select>
  <label for="s1">Baker #1</label><select id="s1"></select>
  <label for="s2">Baker #2</label><select id="s2"></select>
  <label for="s3">Bench <span>(subs in when a starter leaves)</span></label><select id="s3"></select>
  <p class="err" id="dlgErr" role="alert"></p>
  <div class="actions">
    <button class="btn" id="dlgDelete" type="button">Remove player</button>
    <span style="display:flex;gap:8px">
      <button class="btn" id="dlgCancel" type="button">Cancel</button>
      <button class="btn primary" id="dlgSave" type="button">Save picks</button>
    </span>
  </div>
</dialog>

<script>
(function(){
  // bunting
  var cols=['#c8324a','#ffffff','#2b3f6b'],f='';
  for(var i=0;i<16;i++){var x=i*30+2;f+='<path d="M'+x+' 4 L'+(x+26)+' 4 L'+(x+13)+' 31 Z" fill="'+cols[i%3]+'" stroke="#9aa7a5" stroke-width=".5"/>';}
  document.getElementById('flags').innerHTML=f;
  // tent scene
  (function(){
    var P=['#f7a8b8','#8ed4cc','#f4cf63','#b9a6e0','#f29b7a','#9cc5f0','#ffffff'],A='#8ed4cc',W='#dcae6e';
    var g='<defs><clipPath id="hc"><rect width="800" height="270" rx="18"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#hc)">';
    g+='<rect width="800" height="270" fill="#fbfaf6"/><path d="M0 0H400L0 105Z" fill="#f0efe8"/><path d="M800 0H400L800 105Z" fill="#f5f4ee"/>';
    [[0,105],[800,105],[190,105],[610,105]].forEach(function(e){g+='<line x1="400" y1="0" x2="'+e[0]+'" y2="'+e[1]+'" stroke="#cfd6d3" stroke-width="3"/>';});
    [[150,46],[400,26],[650,46]].forEach(function(c){g+='<line x1="'+c[0]+'" y1="'+(c[1]-14)+'" x2="'+c[0]+'" y2="'+c[1]+'" stroke="#b9c2bf" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="'+(c[0]-36)+'" y="'+c[1]+'" width="72" height="8" rx="4" fill="#fff" stroke="#d3dad7"/><rect x="'+(c[0]-30)+'" y="'+(c[1]+8)+'" width="60" height="5" fill="#fff7d6" opacity=".8"/>';});
    g+='<rect y="105" width="800" height="100" fill="#f4eddc"/>';
    for(var x=16;x<800;x+=16)g+='<line x1="'+x+'" y1="105" x2="'+x+'" y2="205" stroke="#ebe2cb"/>';
    g+='<rect y="205" width="800" height="65" fill="#cdb083"/><rect y="205" width="800" height="5" fill="#bfa173"/>';
    function shelf(x0,seed){
      g+='<rect x="'+x0+'" y="120" width="176" height="84" fill="#fbf7ec" stroke="'+A+'" stroke-width="5"/>';
      [148,176,202].forEach(function(sy,row){
        if(row<2)g+='<line x1="'+x0+'" y1="'+sy+'" x2="'+(x0+176)+'" y2="'+sy+'" stroke="'+A+'" stroke-width="4"/>';
        for(var k=0;k<8;k++){
          var c=P[(k*3+row*2+seed)%7],cx=x0+14+k*20,by=sy-(row<2?2:3);
          if((k+row+seed)%3===0)g+='<rect x="'+(cx-5)+'" y="'+(by-17)+'" width="11" height="17" rx="2" fill="'+c+'" stroke="rgba(0,0,0,.15)"/><rect x="'+(cx-4)+'" y="'+(by-20)+'" width="9" height="3" fill="'+W+'"/>';
          else g+='<path d="M'+(cx-8)+' '+(by-10)+'h17a8.5 10 0 0 1-17 0z" fill="'+c+'" stroke="rgba(0,0,0,.15)"/>';
        }
      });
    }
    shelf(72,0);shelf(552,3);
    g+='<rect x="12" y="118" width="46" height="87" rx="9" fill="'+A+'" stroke="rgba(0,0,0,.12)"/><line x1="12" y1="146" x2="58" y2="146" stroke="rgba(0,0,0,.15)"/><rect x="48" y="126" width="3" height="14" rx="1.5" fill="#fff"/><rect x="48" y="152" width="3" height="22" rx="1.5" fill="#fff"/>';
    g+='<rect x="742" y="118" width="46" height="87" rx="9" fill="#aab6a6" stroke="rgba(0,0,0,.12)"/><line x1="742" y1="146" x2="788" y2="146" stroke="rgba(0,0,0,.15)"/><rect x="749" y="126" width="3" height="14" rx="1.5" fill="#fff"/><rect x="749" y="152" width="3" height="22" rx="1.5" fill="#fff"/>';

  function elimMap(){

  function playedWeeks(){var m=0;for(var n=1;n<=totalWeeks();n++){var w=week(n);if((w.out&&w.out.length)||w.star||w.handNone||(w.hand&&w.hand.length)||(w.tech||[]).some(Boolean))m=n;}if(S.season&&S.season.winner)m=totalWeeks();return m;}
  // week the bench baker starts scoring as SUB (0: not subbed in)
  function subFromFor(p,raw){
    var picks=p.picks||[],e=0;
    for(var i=0;i<3;i++){var w=raw[picks[i]];if(w&&(!e||w<e))e=w;}
    if(!e||!picks[3])return 0;
    var b=raw[picks[3]];
    if(b&&b<=e)return 0;
    return e+1;
  }
  function bakerPoints(id,raw,played,from){
    var surv=0,award=0,T=totalWeeks();
    for(var n=Math.max(from||1,SCORE_FROM);n<=played;n++){
      if(raw[id]&&raw[id]<n)break;
      var w=week(n),t=w.tech||[];
      if(n<T&&!(raw[id]&&raw[id]<=n))surv+=1;
      if(w.star===id)award+=5;
      if((w.hand||[]).indexOf(id)>=0)award+=4;
      if(t[0]===id)award+=3;else if(t[1]===id)award+=2;else if(t[2]===id)award+=1;
    }
    return{surv:surv,award:award};
  }
  function standings(){
    var el=elimMap(),raw=rawElim(),played=playedWeeks(),win=S.season&&S.season.winner;
    var list=S.players.map(function(p){
      var picks=p.picks||[],alive=0,lastOut=0,surv=0,bonus=0,end=0,subFrom=subFromFor(p,raw);
      picks.forEach(function(id,i){

        var bp=bakerPoints(id,raw,played,i===3?subFrom:1);surv+=bp.surv;bonus+=bp.award;
        if(win){
          if(id===win)end+=(i===0?15:10);
          else if(!raw[id])end+=7;
        }
      });
      return{p:p,subFrom:subFrom,idx:alive?0:4,alive:alive,lastOut:lastOut,surv:surv,bonus:bonus,end:end,hasWin:win&&picks.indexOf(win)>=0?1:0,pts:surv+bonus+end};
    });
    list.sort(function(a,b){
      return b.pts-a.pts||b.alive-a.alive||b.hasWin-a.hasWin||a.p.name.localeCompare(b.p.name);
    });

  }

  function pIcon(id,cls){
    var order=S.players.slice().sort(function(a,b){return (a.createdAt||0)-(b.createdAt||0)||(a.id<b.id?-1:1);}).map(function(p){return p.id;});
    var i=Math.max(0,order.indexOf(id)),bg=MIX[(i*5+1)%6];
    return '<svg class="'+cls+'" viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="24" cy="24" r="24" fill="'+bg+'"/>'+ICONS[i%ICONS.length](bg)+'</svg>';

      s+='<rect x="18" y="52" width="84" height="24" rx="4" fill="#f7a8b8"'+k+'/><path d="M18 56q7 12 14 0t14 0 14 0 14 0 14 0 14 0v-4h-84z" fill="#fff"/>';
      s+='<rect x="30" y="30" width="60" height="22" rx="4" fill="#8ed4cc"'+k+'/><path d="M30 34q7.5 11 15 0t15 0 15 0 15 0v-4h-60z" fill="#fff"/>';
      s+='<rect x="42" y="12" width="36" height="18" rx="4" fill="#f4cf63"'+k+'/><path d="M42 16q6 9 12 0t12 0 12 0v-4h-36z" fill="#fff"/>';

      s+='<ellipse cx="60" cy="88" rx="52" ry="7" fill="#fff"'+k+'/><path d="M16 84l8-22h72l8 22z" fill="#d99a4e" stroke="#b07a35"/>';
      s+='<path d="M20 62a40 26 0 0 1 80 0z" fill="#e3b469" stroke="#b07a35"/>';

      s+='<path d="M27 52h66M35 43h50" stroke="#b07a35" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>';
      for(var c=0;c<8;c++)s+='<circle cx="'+(25+c*10)+'" cy="62" r="5" fill="#e3b469" stroke="#b07a35"/>';
    }else{
      s+='<ellipse cx="60" cy="92" rx="34" ry="5" fill="#fff"'+k+'/><path d="M36 58h48l-7 34h-34z" fill="#8ed4cc"'+k+'/>';
      for(var q=0;q<5;q++)s+='<line x1="'+(42+q*9)+'" y1="60" x2="'+(46+q*7)+'" y2="90" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2.5"/>';
      s+='<ellipse cx="60" cy="56" rx="28" ry="10" fill="#f7a8b8"'+k+'/><ellipse cx="60" cy="44" rx="21" ry="9" fill="#f9bcc8"'+k+'/><ellipse cx="60" cy="34" rx="13" ry="7" fill="#f7a8b8"'+k+'/>';
      s+='<path d="M60 24q3-8 9-8" fill="none" stroke="#3f7d3a" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="60" cy="25" r="5.5" fill="#c8324a"/>';
      [[44,54,'#f4cf63'],[70,57,'#fff'],[52,42,'#9cc5f0'],[70,44,'#f4cf63'],[58,58,'#9cc5f0']].forEach(function(d){s+='<rect x="'+d[0]+'" y="'+d[1]+'" width="6" height="2.5" rx="1.2" fill="'+d[2]+'" transform="rotate(30 '+d[0]+' '+d[1]+')"/>';});
    }
    return s+'</svg>';
  }
  function techTable(list){
    var h='<div class="tech"><p class="tech-title">Current Standings</p><div class="tech-row">';
    for(var i=0;i<3;i++){
      var g=list.filter(function(r){return r.rank===i+1;}),names='';
      g.forEach(function(r){names+='<span class="pl"><b>'+esc(r.p.name)+'</b></span>';});
      h+='<div class="place p'+(i+1)+'"><div class="tag'+(g.length?'':' empty')+(g.length>3?' many':'')+'">'+(g.length?names:'<b>Open spot</b>')+'<small>'+(g.length?g[0].pts+' pts'+(g.length>1?' each':''):'no one yet')+'</small></div>'+dessert(i)+'<div class="num">'+(i+1)+'</div></div>';
    }
    return h+'</div></div>';
  }

  function renderStandings(){
    var el=elimMap(),list=standings(),win=S.season.winner;
    var inRun=list.filter(function(r){return r.idx<4;}).length;
    var left=bakers().filter(function(b){return !el[b.id];}).length;
    var raw=rawElim(),played=playedWeeks(),maxPts=Math.max(1,list.length?list[0].pts:1);
    var top=list.filter(function(r){return r.rank===1;});
    var leader=(!list.length||!list[0].pts)?'Wide open':(top.length>1?top.length+'-way tie':esc(top[0].p.name));
    var h=techTable(list)+'<div class="tiles"><div class="tile"><b>'+played+' of '+totalWeeks()+'</b><span>weeks played</span></div><div class="tile"><b>'+left+'</b><span>bakers in the tent</span></div><div class="tile"><b>'+list.length+'</b><span>players</span></div><div class="tile hi"><b>'+leader+'</b><span>in the lead</span></div></div>';
    h+='<div class="bar"><p>'+(S.season.locked?'Picks are locked.':'Picks are open.')+'</p><span style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">';
    if(S.isOwner&&S.db)h+='<button class="btn" data-act="lock">'+(S.season.locked?'Unlock picks':'Lock picks')+'</button>';
    if(canEditPicks())h+='<button class="btn primary" data-act="add">Add picks</button>';
    h+='</span></div>';
    if(!list.length){
      h+='<p class="notice">No picks yet. '+(canEditPicks()?'Choose Add picks to enter the first player.':'Picks will show up here once they are entered.')+'</p>';
    }else{
      h+='<ol class="rows">';
      list.forEach(function(r){
        var out=r.idx===4;
        var st=out?'All four bakers out by week '+r.lastOut:r.alive+' of 4 bakers still in';
        st+='. '+r.surv+' survival'+(r.bonus?' + '+r.bonus+' awards':'')+(r.end?' + '+r.end+' finale':'');
        h+='<li class="row'+(r.rank===1&&!out?' lead':'')+(out?' out':'')+'"><div class="rank'+(r.pts&&r.rank<=3?' r'+r.rank:'')+'">'+r.rank+'</div><div class="whoWrap">'+pIcon(r.p.id,'pmini')+'<div><div class="who">'+esc(r.p.name)+'</div><div class="status">'+st+'</div></div></div><div class="pts"><strong>'+r.pts+'</strong> pts';
        if(canEditPicks())h+='<br><button class="btn small" data-act="edit" data-id="'+esc(r.p.id)+'">Edit</button>';
        h+='</div><div class="meter" aria-hidden="true"><i style="width:'+Math.round(r.pts/maxPts*100)+'%"></i></div><div class="slots">';
        (r.p.picks||[]).forEach(function(id,i){
          var cls=el[id]?'gone':(id===win?'champ':(i===0?'active':''));
          var bi=bakers().findIndex(function(b){return b.id===id;}),sub=i===3&&r.subFrom,bp=i===3&&!sub?null:bakerPoints(id,raw,played,sub?r.subFrom:1);
          h+='<div class="slot '+cls+'"><span class="mini" style="background:'+MIX[(bi<0?0:bi)%6]+'">'+(PHOTOS[id]?'<img src="'+PHOTOS[id]+'" alt="">':esc(bName(id).charAt(0)))+'</span><div><small>'+(sub?'SUB, in from week '+r.subFrom:SLOTS[i])+(el[id]?', left week '+el[id]:'')+'</small><b>'+esc(bName(id))+'</b><em>'+(bp?(bp.surv+bp.award)+' pts':(el[id]?'Never subbed in':'Not scoring yet'))+'</em></div></div>';
        });
        h+='</div></li>';
      });
      h+='</ol>';
    }
    h+='<p class="rules">How points work: week 1 is not scored, because picks were made after it aired. Your captain, Baker #1 and Baker #2 score from week 2. Each week a baker earns 5 for Star Baker, 4 for a handshake, 3, 2 or 1 for finishing first, second or third in the technical, and 1 for surviving the episode. Your bench baker scores nothing until one of your three starters is eliminated. They then come in as your SUB and start scoring the following week. There is one sub per player, and a SUB always scores as a regular baker, even when replacing the captain. In the finale you get 15 if your captain wins, 10 if another of your scoring bakers wins, and 7 for each of your scoring bakers who reaches the finale without winning. Players level on points share the same standing.</p>';
    view.innerHTML=h;
  }

  var PHOTOS={"connie": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "clara": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "yannis": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "tom": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "shannon": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "nikki": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "moyin": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "molly": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "mo": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "gary": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "gabe": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "danni": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"}; // baker id -> image data URI
  var MIX=['#f7a8b8','#8ed4cc','#f4cf63','#b9a6e0','#f29b7a','#9cc5f0'];
  function stationArt(i,gone){
    var m=MIX[i%6],b1=MIX[(i+2)%6],b2=MIX[(i+4)%6],k=' stroke="rgba(0,0,0,.18)"';
    var s='<svg class="art" viewBox="0 0 300 104" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="300" height="104" fill="#e2b678"/>';
    for(var x=25;x<300;x+=25)s+='<line x1="'+x+'" y1="0" x2="'+x+'" y2="104" stroke="#d2a25f" stroke-width="1.5"/>';
    for(var j=0;j<12;j++)s+='<line x1="'+(j*25)+'" y1="'+(20+(j*37)%70)+'" x2="'+(j*25+25)+'" y2="'+(20+(j*37)%70)+'" stroke="#d2a25f" stroke-width="1.5"/>';
    s+='<rect x="218" y="12" width="72" height="80" rx="6" fill="#1d1f22"/>';
    [[238,34,11],[270,34,8],[238,68,8],[270,68,11]].forEach(function(c){s+='<circle cx="'+c[0]+'" cy="'+c[1]+'" r="'+c[2]+'" fill="none" stroke="#6a6d72" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="'+c[0]+'" cy="'+c[1]+'" r="'+(c[2]-4)+'" fill="none" stroke="#3d4045" stroke-width="1"/>';});
    s+='<circle cx="248" cy="86" r="1.5" fill="#c8324a"/><circle cx="254" cy="86" r="1.5" fill="#6a6d72"/><circle cx="260" cy="86" r="1.5" fill="#6a6d72"/>';
    if(gone)return s+'</svg>';
    // stand mixer
    s+='<rect x="12" y="22" width="44" height="66" rx="13" fill="'+m+'"'+k+'/><circle cx="34" cy="66" r="17" fill="#cfd5d9" stroke="#9aa3a8"/><circle cx="34" cy="66" r="12.5" fill="#f6f1e4"/><rect x="23" y="12" width="22" height="46" rx="10" fill="'+m+'"'+k+'/><circle cx="34" cy="22" r="3" fill="rgba(255,255,255,.7)"/>';
    // nest of bowls
    s+='<circle cx="92" cy="34" r="21" fill="'+b1+'"'+k+'/><circle cx="92" cy="34" r="15" fill="'+b2+'"'+k+'/><circle cx="92" cy="34" r="10" fill="#fffaf0"/>';
    // rolling pin
    s+='<g transform="rotate(-16 112 82)"><rect x="68" y="80" width="12" height="4" rx="2" fill="#b98445"/><rect x="144" y="80" width="12" height="4" rx="2" fill="#b98445"/><rect x="78" y="76" width="68" height="12" rx="6" fill="#f1d6a8" stroke="#b98445"/></g>';
    // board and bake
    s+='<rect x="138" y="12" width="68" height="56" rx="5" fill="#f3e3c3" stroke="#c9a66b"/><circle cx="198" cy="20" r="2.5" fill="#c9a66b"/>';
    var t=i%4;
    if(t===0){s+='<circle cx="170" cy="40" r="21" fill="#fff"'+k+'/><circle cx="170" cy="40" r="15" fill="#f7a8b8"/>';for(var a=0;a<6;a++)s+='<circle cx="'+(170+10*Math.cos(a*1.047)).toFixed(1)+'" cy="'+(40+10*Math.sin(a*1.047)).toFixed(1)+'" r="2.4" fill="#c8324a"/>';s+='<circle cx="170" cy="40" r="2.4" fill="#fff"/>';}
    else if(t===1){[[154,28],[171,28],[188,30],[154,48],[171,50],[188,50]].forEach(function(c,n){s+='<circle cx="'+c[0]+'" cy="'+c[1]+'" r="7" fill="#d99a4e" stroke="#b07a35"/><circle cx="'+c[0]+'" cy="'+c[1]+'" r="3.5" fill="'+(n%2?'#fff':'#f7a8b8')+'"/>';});}
    else if(t===2){s+='<rect x="148" y="24" width="48" height="32" rx="15" fill="#c98a45" stroke="#9a6428"/>';for(var q=0;q<4;q++)s+='<line x1="'+(160+q*9)+'" y1="31" x2="'+(156+q*9)+'" y2="49" stroke="#f1d6a8" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>';}
    else{s+='<circle cx="170" cy="40" r="21" fill="#cfd5d9" stroke="#9aa3a8"/><circle cx="170" cy="40" r="17" fill="#8a2d4f"/>';for(var z=-12;z<=12;z+=8)s+='<line x1="'+(170+z)+'" y1="'+(40-Math.sqrt(289-z*z)).toFixed(1)+'" x2="'+(170+z)+'" y2="'+(40+Math.sqrt(289-z*z)).toFixed(1)+'" stroke="#e3b469" stroke-width="3"/><line y1="'+(40+z)+'" x1="'+(170-Math.sqrt(289-z*z)).toFixed(1)+'" y2="'+(40+z)+'" x2="'+(170+Math.sqrt(289-z*z)).toFixed(1)+'" stroke="#e3b469" stroke-width="3"/>';s+='<circle cx="170" cy="40" r="17" fill="none" stroke="#e3b469" stroke-width="4"/>';}
    // utensil pot, spoon, timer
    s+='<line x1="182" y1="88" x2="204" y2="74" stroke="#b98445" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="182" y1="88" x2="202" y2="96" stroke="#9aa3a8" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="180" cy="88" r="9" fill="'+b1+'"'+k+'/><circle cx="180" cy="88" r="5" fill="rgba(0,0,0,.2)"/>';
    s+='<circle cx="152" cy="88" r="7" fill="#fff"'+k+'/><line x1="152" y1="88" x2="152" y2="83.5" stroke="#c8324a" stroke-width="1.5"/>';
    return s+'</svg>';
  }

  function awardTiles(id){
    var c=[0,0,0,0,0];
    for(var n=1;n<=totalWeeks();n++){var w=week(n),t=w.tech||[];if(w.star===id)c[0]++;if((w.hand||[]).indexOf(id)>=0)c[1]++;for(var k=0;k<3;k++)if(t[k]===id)c[2+k]++;}
    var h='<div class="mts">';
    ['Star Baker','Hand shakes','Tech 1st','Tech 2nd','Tech 3rd'].forEach(function(l,i){h+='<div class="mt'+(c[i]?' on':'')+'"><b>'+c[i]+'</b><span>'+l+'</span></div>';});
    return h+'</div>';
  }
  function renderBakers(){
    var el=elimMap(),win=S.season.winner,raw=rawElim(),played=playedWeeks();
    var h='<div class="floor"><div class="front">Front of the tent</div><div class="stations">';
    bakers().forEach(function(b,bi){
      var sc=starCount(b.id);
      var by=[];S.players.forEach(function(p){var i=(p.picks||[]).indexOf(b.id);if(i>=0)by.push('<li>'+esc(p.name)+', '+(i===3&&subFromFor(p,raw)?'SUB':SLOTS[i])+'</li>');});
      h+='<div class="station'+(el[b.id]?' gone':'')+(b.id===win?' champ':'')+'">'+stationArt(bi,!!el[b.id])+'<span class="towel" aria-hidden="true"></span><div class="info"><span class="face">'+(PHOTOS[b.id]?'<img src="'+PHOTOS[b.id]+'" alt="">':esc(b.name.charAt(0)))+'</span><div><h3>'+esc(b.name)+'</h3><p>'+(b.id===win?'Winner':el[b.id]?'Left in week '+el[b.id]:'In the tent')+'</p></div>'+awardTiles(b.id)+'<div class="rest"><p class="stars">'+(function(){var x=bakerPoints(b.id,raw,played);return 'Total Points: '+(x.surv+x.award);})()+'</p>'+
        (by.length?'<p class="pk">Picked by</p><ul class="pkl">'+by.join('')+'</ul>':'<p>Nobody picked them</p>')+'</div></div></div>';
    });
    view.innerHTML=h+'</div></div>';
  }

  function renderWeeks(){
    var h='',gone={},host=S.isOwner&&S.db;
    if(host)h+='<p class="notice" style="margin-bottom:12px">You are the host. For each week, tap who left the tent and who got a handshake, then use the dropdowns for Star Baker and the technical top three. Changes save straight away for everyone.</p>';
    function opts(list,val){var o='<option value="">Not set</option>';list.forEach(function(b){o+='<option value="'+esc(b.id)+'"'+(val===b.id?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(b.name)+'</option>';});return o;}
    for(var n=1;n<=totalWeeks();n++){
      var w=week(n),t=w.tech||[],hand=w.hand||[],inTent=bakers().filter(function(b){return !gone[b.id];});
      h+='<section class="week"><header><span class="bis" aria-hidden="true">'+n+'</span><h2>'+(!host&&w.theme?esc(w.theme)+' week':'Week '+n)+'</h2>';
      if(host)h+='<input type="text" data-theme="'+n+'" maxlength="30" placeholder="Theme" aria-label="Week '+n+' theme" value="'+esc(w.theme||'')+'">';
      h+='</header>';
      if(n<SCORE_FROM)h+='<p class="sum"><strong>Not scored.</strong> Picks were made after this episode, so points start in week '+SCORE_FROM+'.</p>';
      if(host){
        h+='<p class="fl">Left the tent</p><div class="chips">';
        inTent.forEach(function(b){h+='<button class="chip" data-out="'+n+'" data-b="'+esc(b.id)+'" aria-pressed="'+((w.out||[]).indexOf(b.id)>=0)+'">'+esc(b.name)+'</button>';});
        h+='</div><p class="fl">Handshakes</p><div class="chips">';
        h+='<button class="chip hs" data-hand="'+n+'" data-b="__none" aria-pressed="'+(!!w.handNone&&!hand.length)+'">None</button>';
        inTent.forEach(function(b){h+='<button class="chip hs" data-hand="'+n+'" data-b="'+esc(b.id)+'" aria-pressed="'+(hand.indexOf(b.id)>=0)+'">'+esc(b.name)+'</button>';});
        h+='</div><div class="sels">';
        h+='<span><label for="star'+n+'">Star Baker</label><select id="star'+n+'" data-star="'+n+'">'+opts(inTent,w.star)+'</select></span>';
        ['1st in technical','2nd in technical','3rd in technical'].forEach(function(lab,i){
          h+='<span><label for="t'+n+'_'+i+'">'+lab+'</label><select id="t'+n+'_'+i+'" data-tech="'+n+'" data-pos="'+i+'">'+opts(inTent,t[i]||null)+'</select></span>';
        });
        if(n===totalWeeks())h+='<span><label for="winSel">Winner</label><select id="winSel" data-win="1">'+opts(inTent,S.season.winner)+'</select></span>';
        h+='</div>';
      }else{
        var outs=(w.out||[]).map(bName),tt=t.filter(Boolean);
        if(!outs.length&&!w.star&&!hand.length&&!tt.length&&!w.handNone)h+='<p class="sum">Nothing recorded yet.</p>';
        else{
          h+='<p class="sum">Left the tent: <strong>'+(outs.length?esc(outs.join(', ')):'nobody')+'</strong></p>';
          if(w.star)h+='<p class="sum">Star Baker: <strong>'+esc(bName(w.star))+'</strong></p>';
          if(hand.length||w.handNone)h+='<p class="sum">Handshakes: <strong>'+(hand.length?esc(hand.map(bName).join(', ')):'none')+'</strong></p>';
          if(tt.length)h+='<p class="sum">Technical top three: <strong>'+esc([0,1,2].map(function(i){return t[i]?(i+1)+'. '+bName(t[i]):'';}).filter(Boolean).join(', '))+'</strong></p>';
        }
        if(n===totalWeeks()&&S.season.winner)h+='<p class="sum">Winner: <strong>'+esc(bName(S.season.winner))+'</strong></p>';
      }
      h+='</section>';
      (w.out||[]).forEach(function(id){gone[id]=1;});
    }
    view.innerHTML=h;
  }

  function render(){
    renderPub();
    if(S.problem){view.innerHTML='<p class="notice">'+esc(S.problem)+'</p>';return;}
    if(!S.ready){view.innerHTML='<p class="notice">Loading the league…</p>';return;}
    if(!S.season||!bakers().length){view.innerHTML='<p class="notice">The baker lineup has not been loaded yet. Ask the host to set up the season.</p>';return;}
    var a=document.activeElement;
    if(a&&a.matches&&a.matches('input[data-theme]'))return; // do not clobber typing
    if(S.tab==='bakers')renderBakers();else if(S.tab==='weeks')renderWeeks();else renderStandings();
  }

  var entT;function enter(){view.classList.add('enter');clearTimeout(entT);entT=setTimeout(function(){view.classList.remove('enter');},1000);}

  // season writes, one at a time
  var chain=Promise.resolve();
  function saveSeason(mut){
    var next=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(S.season));
    if(!next.weeks)next.weeks={};
    mut(next);
    S.season=next;render();
    chain=chain.then(function(){return S.db.doc('league/season').set(next);}).catch(function(e){
      S.problem='That change could not be saved ('+((e&&e.code)||'error')+'). Reload the page and try again.';render();
    });
  }
  function wk(s,n){if(!s.weeks[n])s.weeks[n]={theme:'',out:[],star:null};if(!s.weeks[n].out)s.weeks[n].out=[];if(!s.weeks[n].hand)s.weeks[n].hand=[];if(!s.weeks[n].tech)s.weeks[n].tech=[null,null,null];return s.weeks[n];}

  document.querySelector('.tabs').addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var b=e.target.closest('button[data-tab]');if(!b)return;
    S.tab=b.dataset.tab;
    document.querySelectorAll('.tabs button').forEach(function(x){x.setAttribute('aria-selected',x===b);});
    if(document.activeElement&&document.activeElement.blur)document.activeElement.blur();
    render();enter();
  });
  view.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var t=e.target.closest('button');if(!t)return;
    if(t.dataset.act==='add')openDialog(null);
    else if(t.dataset.act==='edit')openDialog(t.dataset.id);
    else if(t.dataset.act==='lock')saveSeason(function(s){s.locked=!s.locked;});
    else if(t.dataset.out){
      var n=t.dataset.out,id=t.dataset.b;
      saveSeason(function(s){
        var w=wk(s,n),i=w.out.indexOf(id);
        if(i>=0)w.out.splice(i,1);
        else{
          w.out.push(id);
          for(var m=+n+1;m<=totalWeeks();m++){var later=s.weeks[m];if(later){later.out=(later.out||[]).filter(function(x){return x!==id;});later.hand=(later.hand||[]).filter(function(x){return x!==id;});later.tech=(later.tech||[null,null,null]).map(function(x){return x===id?null:x;});if(later.star===id)later.star=null;}}
          if(s.winner===id)s.winner=null;
        }
      });
    }
    else if(t.dataset.hand){
      var hn=t.dataset.hand,hid=t.dataset.b;
      saveSeason(function(s){var w=wk(s,hn);if(hid==='__none'){w.handNone=!w.handNone;if(w.handNone)w.hand=[];return;}var i=w.hand.indexOf(hid);if(i>=0)w.hand.splice(i,1);else w.hand.push(hid);if(w.hand.length)w.handNone=false;});
    }
  });
  view.addEventListener('change',function(e){
    var t=e.target;
    if(t.dataset.star)saveSeason(function(s){wk(s,t.dataset.star).star=t.value||null;});
    else if(t.dataset.handadd){if(t.value){var hv=t.value,hw=t.dataset.handadd;saveSeason(function(s){var w=wk(s,hw);if(w.hand.indexOf(hv)<0)w.hand.push(hv);});}}
    else if(t.dataset.tech)saveSeason(function(s){var w=wk(s,t.dataset.tech),v=t.value||null;if(v)w.tech=w.tech.map(function(x){return x===v?null:x;});w.tech[+t.dataset.pos]=v;});
    else if(t.dataset.win)saveSeason(function(s){s.winner=t.value||null;});
    else if(t.dataset.theme){var v=t.value.trim();t.blur();saveSeason(function(s){wk(s,t.dataset.theme).theme=v;});}
  });

  // picks dialog
  var dlg=document.getElementById('dlg'),err=document.getElementById('dlgErr'),del=document.getElementById('dlgDelete');
  var confirmDel=false;
  function openDialog(id){
    S.editing=id?S.players.find(function(p){return p.id===id;}):null;
    if(id&&!S.editing)return;
    document.getElementById('dlgTitle').textContent=S.editing?'Edit picks':'Add picks';
    document.getElementById('pName').value=S.editing?S.editing.name:'';
    var list=bakers().slice().sort(function(a,b){return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);});
    for(var i=0;i<4;i++){
      var sel=document.getElementById('s'+i);sel.innerHTML='';
      var o=document.createElement('option');o.value='';o.textContent='Choose a baker';sel.appendChild(o);
      list.forEach(function(b){
        var op=document.createElement('option');op.value=b.id;
        op.textContent=b.name;
        sel.appendChild(op);
      });
      sel.value=S.editing?((S.editing.picks||[])[i]||''):'';
    }
    err.textContent='';confirmDel=false;del.textContent='Remove player';del.style.visibility=S.editing?'visible':'hidden';
    dlg.showModal();
  }
  document.getElementById('dlgCancel').onclick=function(){dlg.close();};
  document.getElementById('dlgSave').onclick=function(){
    var name=document.getElementById('pName').value.trim();
    var picks=[0,1,2,3].map(function(i){return document.getElementById('s'+i).value;});
    if(!name){err.textContent='Add a player name.';return;}
    if(picks.some(function(p){return !p;})){err.textContent='Choose a baker for all four spots.';return;}
    if(new Set(picks).size<4){err.textContent='Each of the four picks has to be a different baker.';return;}
    var body={name:name,picks:picks,createdAt:(S.editing&&S.editing.createdAt)||Date.now()};
    var col=S.db.collection('players');
    var btn=this;btn.disabled=true;
    (S.editing?col.doc(S.editing.id).set(body):col.add(body)).then(function(){dlg.close();}).catch(function(e){
      if(e&&e.code==='invalid_argument'){S.canWrite=false;render();err.textContent='You have view-only access, so picks cannot be saved from this account. Ask the host to add them.';}
      else err.textContent='Picks could not be saved. Try again in a moment.';
    }).then(function(){btn.disabled=false;});
  };
  del.onclick=function(){
    if(!S.editing)return;
    if(!confirmDel){confirmDel=true;del.textContent='Tap again to remove';return;}
    S.db.collection('players').doc(S.editing.id).delete().then(function(){dlg.close();}).catch(function(){err.textContent='Player could not be removed.';});
  };

  // connect
  // public snapshot: shown at once, and kept when live data is unavailable (signed-out visitors)
  var HAS_SNAP=SNAP&&typeof SNAP==='object'&&SNAP.season;
  function enc(v){return JSON.stringify(v).replace(/</g,'\\u003c').replace(/\u2028/g,'\\u2028').replace(/\u2029/g,'\\u2029');}
  function put(str,tok,val){var i=str.indexOf(tok);return i<0?str:str.slice(0,i)+val+str.slice(i+tok.length);}
  function buildPage(T,snap){var q='"';return put(put(T,q+'__SNAP__'+q,enc(snap)),q+'__TPL__'+q,enc(T));}
  function canon(v){if(Array.isArray(v))return '['+v.map(canon).join(',')+']';if(v&&typeof v==='object')return '{'+Object.keys(v).sort().filter(function(k){return v[k]!==undefined;}).map(function(k){return JSON.stringify(k)+':'+canon(v[k]);}).join(',')+'}';return JSON.stringify(v===undefined?null:v);}
  function liveSnap(){return{season:S.season,players:S.players.slice().sort(function(a,b){return a.id<b.id?-1:1;})};}
  var pub=document.getElementById('pub');
  function renderPub(){
    var h='';
    if(S.offline&&HAS_SNAP){
      h='<p class="pubnote">Results as of '+new Date(SNAP.at).toLocaleDateString(undefined,{month:'long',day:'numeric'})+'. Sign in to Claude to see live updates.</p>';
    }else if(S.live&&S.isOwner&&S.art&&S.season){
      var stale=!HAS_SNAP||canon(liveSnap())!==canon({season:SNAP.season,players:SNAP.players});
      if(S.pubErr)h='<p class="pubnote warn">The public view could not be updated from here. Ask Claude to refresh it.</p>';
      else if(stale)h='<p class="pubnote warn">The public link is showing older results. <button class="btn small primary" data-act="pub">Update public view</button></p>';
      else h='<p class="pubnote">The public link is up to date.</p>';
    }
    if(pub.innerHTML!==h)pub.innerHTML=h;
  }
  pub.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var b=e.target.closest('button[data-act="pub"]');if(!b||!S.art)return;
    b.disabled=true;b.textContent='Updating…';
    var snap=liveSnap();snap.at=Date.now();
    try{sessionStorage.setItem('tab',S.tab);}catch(_){}
    chain.then(function(){return S.art.publish(buildPage(TPL,snap));}).catch(function(err){
      if(err&&err.code==='conflict')return;
      S.pubErr=true;renderPub();
    });
  });
  try{var st0=sessionStorage.getItem('tab');if(st0){sessionStorage.removeItem('tab');S.tab=st0;document.querySelectorAll('.tabs button').forEach(function(x){x.setAttribute('aria-selected',x.dataset.tab===st0);});}}catch(_){}
  if(HAS_SNAP){S.season=SNAP.season;S.players=SNAP.players||[];S.ready=true;render();enter();}

  async function start(){
    function offline(msg){S.offline=true;S.db=null;if(!HAS_SNAP)S.problem=msg;render();}
    if(!window.claude||!window.claude.use){offline('Open this page inside Claude to see the league.');return;}
    var res=await Promise.all([window.claude.use('db'),window.claude.use('user'),window.claude.use('artifact')]);
    var db=res[0],user=res[1];
    if(!db){offline('The league data is not available in this view. Sign in to Claude and open the shared link again.');return;}
    if(user){
      var r=await Promise.all([user.isOwner(),user.can('data.write')]);
      S.isOwner=!!r[0];S.canWrite=r[1]===null?true:!!r[1];
    }
    S.art=res[2];
    var got=0;
    function onErr(e){if(HAS_SNAP&&!S.live){if(S.season!==SNAP.season){S.season=SNAP.season;S.players=SNAP.players||[];}offline('');return;}S.problem='Lost the connection to the league data ('+((e&&e.code)||'error')+'). Reload the page.';render();}
    function arrived(bit){got|=bit;var first=!S.ready;if(got===3){S.ready=true;S.live=true;S.db=db;}render();if(first&&S.ready)enter();}
    var seasonLive=null,playersLive=null;
    db.doc('league/season').onSnapshot(function(snap){
      if(snap.metadata&&snap.metadata.hasPendingWrites)return;
      seasonLive=snap.exists?snap.data():null;
      if(got&2||!HAS_SNAP){S.season=seasonLive;if(got&2)S.players=playersLive;}
      arrived(1);
    },onErr);
    db.collection('players').onSnapshot(function(q){
      playersLive=q.docs.map(function(d){var x=d.data()||{};return{id:d.id,name:String(x.name||'Player'),picks:Array.isArray(x.picks)?x.picks:[],createdAt:x.createdAt};});
      if(got&1||!HAS_SNAP){S.players=playersLive;if(got&1)S.season=seasonLive;}
      arrived(2);
    },onErr);
  }
  start();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
